fun_facts: As a sophomore in 2019, Jovantae Barnes rushed for 1,022 yards and 13 touchdowns on 126 carries—an average of 8.1 yards per carry.
In six games in 2021, Jovantae Barnes rushed for 567 yards and 11 touchdowns and earned first-team All-Southern Nevada honors.
Jovantae Barnes was a 2021 Under Armour All-American.
Jovantae Barnes’s career-high rushing game at Oklahoma was 203 yards and three touchdowns against Maine.
Jovantae Barnes says his nickname is “Tae,” and he’s into fashion and styling.
Jovantae Barnes graduated from Oklahoma with a degree in multidisciplinary studies and is working on a second degree in criminal justice at Kentucky.
